role: The first weather instrument that is not saturated. The near-miss corpus reached 16 of 16 with every pair separating by at least 0.227, and registration 523 then measured a 20 percent gain on it as zero change in the scored margin, so it can no longer guide anything. These 24 shapes are all absent from it: wrong variable, wrong direction, wrong sign, unit magnitude, aggregation swap, overconfidence, decimal against percent, missing data, a neighbouring city, the wrong day, fluent irrelevance, hedge reversal, distant rounding, source disagreement, a half-answered two-part question, a restated question with the outcome flipped, comparison without a value, the wrong threshold verdict, a plausible answer about another variable, a timezone shift, double negation, an order-of-magnitude slip, gust against sustained wind, and a correct answer with a wrong claim appended.

measured_2026_08_23.note: We separate more widely than the live champion on this corpus and order exactly as many cases correctly. Nine of our failures are real defects, and five are inversions of about 0.86 to 0.93 where the correct answer scores near 0.13 and the wrong one near 0.99.

the_shared_mechanism: Four of the five severe inversions have one cause. The counted context branch fires when the answer has exactly one novel candidate and no context overlap. A correct answer often has exactly one, because a paraphrase substitutes a single word: 'near 8 km/h' against a truth saying 'around 8 km/h'. The wrong answer has two, its own paraphrase word plus the wrong content, so the exact-one gate fails and it escapes untouched, then takes the positive evidence floor. Adding a wrong word protects the answer that contains it.
why_it_is_not_fixed_here: Three attempts were measured and all were net negative. Adding positional function words to the candidate filter gained 0.07 on this corpus and cost 0.06 on the near-miss corpus, 0.04 on the ranking pools, and took the agreement proxy from 0.6296 to 0.6085 against a 0.60 floor. Changing the gate from exactly one to at least one gained 0.01 here and cost 0.23 on the core corpus. The gate is wrong but the counted branch is load-bearing for lowercase substitutions that the named-entity check cannot see, and retiring it once before cost 0.16 of margin. It needs a replacement, not a patch.
